name: Sync UUIDs
description: Provides a Drush command to synchronize entity UUIDs (for aligning config across environments).
project_description:
During development, you often have to upload code from the

version control system to multiple servers. You can use this

module to synchronize the configuration. Also, this module

can be useful if you install to the site a module containing

configurations (in this case, the module will create configurations

on the site with different UUIDs on each server, so you need to sync

them).

 How to use:

 drush su OR drush sync-uuids
